name: Forever & Ever
source:
"Forever & Ever" is a Doki Doki Literature Club mod providing you the ability to be alone with Sayori. This mod is designed like Monika After Story but has a few differences to date, including the wonderful Sayori as the star of the show.

[From the [url=https://github.com/ForeverAndEverTeam/fae-mod]fan game page on GitHub[/url]]
translation:
《Forever & Ever》是一款《心跳文学部》模组，让你能够与纱世里独处。本作的设计类似《莫妮卡后日谈》，不过目前已有一些不同之处，其中最显著的一点，就是可爱的纱世里成为了主角。

[摘自[url=https://github.com/ForeverAndEverTeam/fae-mod]GitHub上的同人游戏页面[/url]]
